title: Helping at Home
description: Practise have to, must and housework words, and write about helping at home.
instructions: Do the exercises in Part 1. Then write about helping at home in Part 2.

exercises.text: 🧹 I ___ the floor with a brush.
exercises.explanation: You sweep the floor with a brush.

exercises.text: I ___ to tidy my room every day.
exercises.explanation: "Have to" means you must do it.

exercises.prompt: Put the words in the correct order to make a sentence.
answers: Dad washes the dishes after dinner.
After dinner Dad washes the dishes.

exercises.prompt: There is one mistake in the sentence. Write the correct sentence.
exercises.text: Mai have to help her mum on Saturday.
answers: Mai has to help her mum on Saturday.
exercises.explanation: With he, she, it we say "has to".

exercises.text: You ___ be kind and help your family.
Please put your toys ___ the box.
exercises.explanation: We put things in a box.
Use "is cooking" for something happening now.

exercises.prompt: Put the words in the correct order to make a sentence.
There is one mistake in the sentence. Write the correct sentence.
exercises.text: Linh is wash the car with her dad.
answers: Linh is washing the car with her dad.

exercises.text: Yesterday I ___ my grandma in the kitchen.

exercises.prompt: Write the past simple of the word in brackets.
exercises.text: My brother ___ his bed this morning. (make)
I tidy my room ___ every morning.
exercises.explanation: Use an adverb to say how you do it.

exercises.prompt: Put the words in the correct order to make a sentence.
answers: Tom did not tidy his room.
exercises.explanation: Subject + did not + base verb + thing.

exercises.prompt: There is one mistake in the sentence. Write the correct sentence.
answers: I did not clean my room.
exercises.explanation: After "didn't" use the base verb: clean.

exercises.prompt: Write the verb in brackets in the correct form.
exercises.text: My mum and I ___ the dishes together after dinner. (wash)
exercises.explanation: With I and plural subjects use the base verb: wash.

task.prompt: Write about how you help at home.
task.modelAnswer: I help my mum and dad at home every day. I have to tidy my room and I wash the dishes after dinner. Yesterday I helped my dad in the garden. We watered the plants. I feel happy because I help my family.
